title: List resources with default pagination
description: Call a collection GET endpoint with no query params. Expect 200 and a JSON array (possibly empty) matching the documented item schema.

title: Create resource with all optional fields populated
description: Send a request body including every optional field, not just required ones. Expect the success status code and a response echoing all provided fields.

title: Partial update only changes targeted fields
description: PATCH a resource with a single field. Expect 200 and confirm unrelated fields remain unchanged in the response.

title: Duplicate unique field rejected
description: Create a resource with a field value (e.g. email/username) that already exists. Expect 409 Conflict or 400 with a clear validation error.

title: Wrong data type for field
description: Send a string where a number is expected (or vice versa). Expect 400 Bad Request with a schema validation error.

title: Array field at max item count
description: Send an array field at exactly its documented maxItems, and one item over. Expect success at the limit and rejection just beyond it.

title: Nested object response schema validation
description: Validate that nested objects/arrays in the response body match the documented schema, including required sub-fields and types.

title: Nullable field returns null, not omitted
description: For fields marked nullable in the schema, verify the API returns an explicit null rather than omitting the key entirely.

title: Concurrent modification / stale write
description: Update the same resource from two 'concurrent' requests using stale data (e.g. missing If-Match/ETag). Verify the API either rejects the stale write or applies last-write-wins consistently.

title: Idempotency key prevents duplicate creation
description: Send the same POST request twice with an identical idempotency key. Expect the second request to return the original resource, not create a duplicate.

owasp: API6:2023 Unrestricted Access to Sensitive Business Flows
title: Automated bulk creation abuse
description: Rapidly issue many creation requests in a short window (e.g. account signups, coupon redemptions). Expect rate limiting or CAPTCHA-style friction, not unlimited automation.

title: Verbose stack trace on server error
description: Trigger an unhandled server error (e.g. malformed input causing a 500). Verify the response does not leak stack traces, internal paths, or framework versions.

title: Deprecated/legacy API version still reachable
description: Probe for old API versions (e.g. /v1/ when /v2/ is current). Verify deprecated versions are disabled or have equivalent security controls.

title: Overly permissive CORS policy
description: Send a request with an arbitrary Origin header. Verify Access-Control-Allow-Origin is not '*' combined with credentials, and only trusted origins are reflected.

title: JWT 'alg: none' acceptance
description: Send a JWT with its algorithm header set to 'none' and signature stripped. Expect the token to be rejected as invalid/unauthenticated.

title: [Sample Dataset] Duplicate unique field rejected
description: Create a resource with an email that already exists. Expect 409 Conflict.
expected_response: Response matches documented behavior for status 409.
assertions: Response body includes a conflict error message
notes: Confirmed correct behavior in staging; keep as reference pattern.

title: [Sample Dataset] Overly aggressive rate limit test
description: Original template assumed a fixed 100 req/min limit for all endpoints, which does not hold across this API's tiers.
expected_response: Response matches documented behavior for status 429.
notes: Rejected: rate limit thresholds vary per plan tier; needs per-endpoint configuration before reuse.

title: [Sample Dataset] Mass assignment of restricted fields
description: Include an 'isAdmin' field in a user-creation payload sent by a non-admin caller.
expected_response: isAdmin is ignored/stripped from the created resource, not silently set to true.
assertions: Created resource does not have isAdmin=true
notes: Modified: original test only checked status code; added assertion that isAdmin was actually ignored.

title: [Sample Dataset] Nullable field returns null, not omitted
description: GET a resource whose optional 'middleName' field was never set. Expect the key to be present with value null.
assertions: Response body contains key 'middleName' with value null

title: [Sample Dataset] Idempotency key prevents duplicate creation
description: POST the same payload twice with the same Idempotency-Key header. Expect only one resource created.
expected_response: Second response returns the same resource id as the first.
assertions: Response status code is 201 on first call, 200 on repeat
Both responses reference the same resource id
